Unlace your shoes hands-free. Just double-tap your heel to the arch of your standing foot, then repeat on the other side.
We made unlacing even easier. Just tap your heel twice to the inside of your foot to unlace, then repeat on the other side.
We’re making unlacing easier. Double-tap your heel to the inside of your standing foot to unlace, then repeat on the other side.
Now try it out! You can access settings for this Gesture in My Shoes.
Heel Tap to Unlace is On
Firmly tap the inside of your foot two times. Make sure you’re not tapping too fast or too slow.
Lift one foot and double-tap the heel to the arch of your standing foot — the shoe you tapped should unlace. Make sure to tap firmly at a 90-degree angle.
You’ve successfully unlaced one shoe. Now let’s practice on the other side.
Now the other shoe. Lift your foot and double-tap the heel to the arch of your standing foot.
Place both feet firmly on the ground before trying this Gesture.
Double-tap your heel to the arch (middle area) of your standing foot.
Use steady, firm taps. Not too fast or too slow.
